thread:
Maria R.: Quick check — midweek triage: can we shift Weds 10:00 -> 11:00 for better overlap with EU? Also propose trying a 30m boxed triage + two 5m lightning slots (backlog + emergent) for the next two weeks. Thoughts? cc @Akshay P. @Devon L.

Akshay P.: 11:00 works for me. 30m could be tight if we have >8 items; maybe keep 45m but timebox to 2 deep items. Lightning slots sound good. +1 for a two-week pilot.

Devon L.: 11:00 is fine. Suggest owners pre-assign 3 issues (high/med/low) ahead of the call so we can defer low to async. Also can we add a quick "blocked by CI" check as a standing item?

Jessie: Agree on pre-assigning — speeds things up. I can take ownership of the bug-queue rota this week and post owners by EOD. :thumbsup:

Lee: Tiny ask — add a "PR unblock pings" bullet so we can call out reviews stuck >48h. Saves follow-ups later.

Maria R.: Sounds good — new agenda draft: 1) owners rollcall (5m) 2) lightning item A (5m) 3) lightning item B (5m) 4) PR unblock check (5m) 5) rollouts/infra blockers (10m) = 30m. If major items emerge, we spin a follow-up. I'll run the first two sessions.

triage-bot: Created event "Midweek Triage (pilot)" on calendar: Wed 11:00–11:30, recurring weekly (starts 1915636700). Link: https://cal/xyz — attendees: eng@redwood, triage-owners.

Akshay P.: Updated owners for the pilot: @Jessie -> bug-queue, @Devon L. -> infra blockers, @Akshay P. -> backlog prioritization. I'll update the triage doc with slots and a short owners checklist.

Maria R.: Thanks — logistics: please add 2–3 candidate items to the triage doc before the meeting. If you're owner and can't attend, tag your backup. I'll take the first two sessions.

Devon L.: Noted. I'll draft a short owner checklist in the doc (what to prepare, quick triage rubric) and ping when ready.

Jessie: Draft owners list posted: https://docs/triage/owners — please add backups and any items. Added a note about "CI flaky tests" as a category so we can triage differently.

Maria R.: Great — closing the loop. If anyone strongly objects to 11:00 / 30m, shout now; otherwise I'll update calendar + README and we start the pilot next Wed. :wave:

Lee: All good from me.
